java_locations.role: Defines the case-insensitive single- and multiline grammar: optional right/left/top/bottom, on|of link, optional ColorParser.simpleColor(BACK), mandatory colon for inline text, and ^end[%s]?note$ for multiline termination. It resolves the last eligible link, defaults position to BOTTOM, reports No link defined when absent, and attaches one CucaNote to that link.
Keeps a recognized opener partial until the registered end regex matches the final trimmed line; unterminated multiline commands are not executed as complete commands.
Expands %s to Java whitespace plus non-breaking space and compiles command and terminator regexes case-insensitively.
Owns the optional background-color token and resolves it through the diagram HColorSet before CucaNote construction.

Allocates the link UID once in the Link constructor and stores exactly one CucaNote. addNote is assignment, so a later command on the same last link replaces the earlier note without changing the link UID or source location.
Carries only display, position, colors, and strategy; it is link-owned data, not a quark-backed Entity with an independent UID or source record.
Selects the most recent link whose endpoints are not NOTE leaves. Note-on-link attachment itself consumes no unique-sequence value.

Builds the ordinary center label, builds EntityImageNoteLink from Link.getNote, and merges the two blocks left/right or top/bottom before Graphviz receives one center-label table. The solved label block and note are painted inside the original link group.
Constructs the DESCRIPTION link and calls Link.getInv for explicit LEFT or UP directions, preserving an inverted-link flag in addition to swapping semantic endpoints.

Promotes the start node of every inverted SvekEdge ahead of ordinary source-order nodes before DOT serialization; the resulting declaration order is observable in same-rank route and compound-label geometry.
Uses the Rose NOTE component for the link-owned folded note and contributes its preferred dimensions to the compound center label without becoming a SVEK node.
Registers both CommandFactoryNoteOnLink forms for the shared DESCRIPTION factory used by Component and Deployment diagrams.

Tries every start-compatible factory in registration order and accepts the first factory that consumes the complete source without returning an error; note-on-link therefore participates in DESCRIPTION viability rather than acting as a standalone State score.

rust_locations.role: Approximates Java factory viability with subtype evidence. The existing bare note-on-link State/UseCase score can outvote Deployment leaves and bypass the parser that now owns the DESCRIPTION command.
Consumes named and attached notes but has no note-on-link command branch. A Java-valid line falls through and parse_deployment returns success without retaining it.
Models standalone or attached note entities and links separately, but DeploymentConnection has no link-owned note value.

Already measures and paints Deployment note chrome and solves ordinary edge labels, but sends only connection.label to Graphviz and emits no link-owned note within the link group. UID reconstruction treats only nodes, standalone/attached notes, and links as source events.

Provides the existing Rust parser analogue for associating inline or multiline note text with a preceding Component connection, including body source handling. Its currently narrower grammar and vector association are evidence, not the Deployment ownership model.
Provides the existing Rust compound-label dimension, block-order, and folded-note paint mechanics that correspond to SvekEdge's TextBlock merges.

claimed_invariant: In a Deployment DESCRIPTION diagram, each ordinary semantic link owns zero or one note-on-link value. The case-insensitive command accepts inline and complete multiline forms with optional right/left/top/bottom, on|of link, and optional resolvable background color; default position is bottom. A note-on-link command remains a viable DESCRIPTION command during factory selection, so DESCRIPTION-only leaves are not displaced by State or UseCase scoring. It attaches to the most recent link whose endpoints are not note entities, replaces any note already on that link, and errors terminally when no eligible prior link exists. The note adds no node, quark, UID, source event, owner, or separate SVG group. SvekEdge expands ordinary labels through Display row controls before measurement, merges note and label blocks according to position, gives Graphviz one compound center-label size, and paints both within the owning link group. ComponentRoseNote's five-pixel preferred-size padding constrains Graphviz but is not itself paint; LimitFinder observes the actual child note and label. Interior empty Display rows serialize as non-breaking-space rows, while a wholly empty display paints no text.
causal_divergence: The first implementation correctly added link-local ownership and compound constraints, but the adversarial review exposed four broader model gaps. detect_uml_subtype gives bare note-on-link a State/UseCase score that can outvote DESCRIPTION deployment leaves, bypassing the Deployment parser. Its later DESCRIPTION viability check also treats the generic score awarded to `note top/right/bottom/left of ...` as proof of explicit Component syntax, even though that score represents a command shared by Component and Deployment; explicit-position link notes therefore remain misclassified. The renderer measures and paints a raw connection label as one string instead of expanding Display \n controls into centered rows, and its row baselines use glyph-dependent Rust ascent rather than PlantUML's font-metric ascent. Its edge bounds include the complete padded compound constraint rather than the actual child paint, promoting invisible ComponentRoseNote padding into the canvas frontier. Empty interior note rows are emitted as zero-width text rather than Java's non-breaking-space Display row. Finally, Deployment swaps LEFT/UP endpoints but discards Java Link's inverted identity, so Cluster cannot promote the inverted start node before DOT serialization; a reversed horizontal compound label can therefore solve five pixels narrower despite an identical fixed table. These are factory viability, Display, LimitFinder, and SVEK declaration-order divergences, not coordinate constants to tune.
planned_model_change: Retain the compact DeploymentLinkNote ownership model. During UML subtype selection, record a complete note-on-link command and separately record only real Component declarations or bracket references as explicit Component evidence; make Deployment viable when DESCRIPTION deployment leaves are present and that explicit evidence is absent, while leaving transition-only State and explicit UseCase evidence dominant in their own families. Project every ordinary connection label through rustuml_parser::display::split_escaped_newlines; measure the widest row, sum row heights, center each row in the label block, and paint each baseline with the same PlantUML font-metric ascent used by Display. Keep the five-pixel ComponentRoseNote padding only in the Graphviz compound constraint and child-origin equations. For LimitFinder bounds, recover child origins and include the painted folded-note rectangle plus the ordinary label block separately, never the invisible outer compound rectangle. Serialize empty interior note rows as NBSP for text measurement/paint, but leave an entirely empty note display textless. Preserve LEFT/UP inverted-link identity by registering each inverted layout start with LayoutGraph before Graphviz node creation, matching Cluster's declaration-order partition without adding a geometry constant.
perturbation_axes: inline versus multiline command and endnote versus end note terminator
on link versus of link and mixed command case
omitted position versus left, right, top, and bottom
link without ordinary label versus link with one- and multi-line ordinary labels
default-position note-on-link with deployment leaves versus transition-only State and explicit UseCase inputs
omitted color versus named and hexadecimal background colors
first note versus repeated replacement on the same link
ordinary prior link versus prior link touching a named note entity versus no prior link
root versus nested Deployment container ownership
top-to-bottom versus left-to-right layout and explicit left/right/up/down link direction
renamed endpoints, labels, and note text with changed lengths
single edge versus chain, fanout, and parallel-edge topology
note followed by later node and link declarations to expose UID/source drift
scope_boundary: This mechanism owns Deployment CommandFactoryNoteOnLink parsing, link-local AST storage, compound center-label constraints, note paint inside the edge group, and preservation of the owning link's UID/source semantics. It does not correct Component's narrower parser grammar, standalone or attached Deployment note semantics, edge routing algorithms, general color syntax outside this command, oracle-assisted SVG replay, comparator behavior, baselines, or held-out checker evidence.
acceptance: Deployment parser tests cover inline and multiline forms, on|of, default and explicit positions, color, nested containers, ordinary labels, repeated replacement, renamed endpoints, changed topology, and terminal no-prior-link behavior.
The parser stores no DeploymentNote or quark for a link note, leaves connection source_line unchanged, and replaces rather than accumulates repeated notes.

Renderer tests prove both note-only and Display-row-label-plus-note center blocks constrain layout and paint centered rows plus the folded note inside the owning link group for representative horizontal and vertical merges.
Subtype tests prove default-position note-on-link retains Deployment when DESCRIPTION leaves are present without stealing transition-only State or explicit UseCase inputs.
Bounds tests project actual note and label children rather than invisible compound padding, and interior blank rows use Java's NBSP display atom.
Renderer tests prove a link note adds no entity group or UID event and leaves later entity/link IDs and data-source-line metadata unchanged.
Focused parser and renderer tests, full affected-crate tests, clippy with warnings denied, and cargo build --release -p rustuml pass.
An independent checker, not the maker, later generates held-out Java perturbations and authors review.json at the exact implementation revision.
forbidden_approaches: special-casing the triggering review fixture, endpoint names, labels, note text, branch count, or expected coordinates
representing a link note as a standalone DeploymentNote, layout node, quark, generated entity, hidden helper edge, or independent SVG group
painting the note after layout without including its compound dimensions in the Graphviz center-label input
appending repeated notes instead of following Link.addNote replacement semantics
post-hoc SVG string insertion or coordinate surgery
reading golden SVGs or oracle output from shipping crates
changing comparator slack, eligibility, baselines, park lists, or guard allow-lists
declared_residue: Exact Java syntax-error SVG artwork, exit code, error wording, and selected error line remain outside parser acceptance and AST non-mutation.

ColorParser.PART2 is present in the factory's nominal regex, but frozen-oracle probes such as `note left on link #back:FF0000;line:00FF00` terminate with PlantUML's No such color error at the command line. This mechanism therefore accepts the simple and gradient values that reach CucaNote construction and terminally rejects the composite form; a future Java revision that executes PART2 successfully would require its own model change.
Component note-on-link grammar and replacement behavior remain a separate existing-family mechanism even when its compound geometry informs this port.
Handwritten note contours and theme-specific NOTE style overrides are not acceptance criteria unless the implementation changes those existing Deployment rendering paths.
Independent perturbation artifacts and review.json are intentionally absent from the maker commit.
